decisions.reason: Making the spouts removable for cleaning does not change the established valve, flow, sequencing, or operator-control behavior.
Spout removability does not alter the requirement that seals prevent liquid from entering the base or electronics.
The decision concerns cleaning and removability, not the spout's mounting location, orientation, material, or appearance.
A removable spout must still satisfy the existing leak-free seal requirement; the source does not change that state.
Spout removability does not change the platform's height, footprint, or cup-clearance purpose.
The source addresses removable spouts, not whisk removal or whisk-assembly clearance.
The removable-spout decision does not change bowl removal, swapping, or clearance behavior.
The source does not change the placement of the speed controls, dispense buttons, or master power control.
Spout removability does not change the required mixing, frothing, whisk, or high-speed performance.
The cleaning decision does not modify splash targets or accepted splash-mitigation methods.
The source does not change the prototype's off-the-shelf electronics strategy.
The freelancer reiterates the already-established K marking without changing its text, style, or button coverage; the color remains unresolved until a later client message.
